answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked for a fixed period and forfeited if a randomly sampled task reveals duplicated identities or fabricated work. The bond makes spawning identities costly: an attacker must tie up real capital for every sybil, while honest agents recover theirs after the audit window. For example, oasis could accept marble-backed bonds valued in quartz credits, with audits chosen after submission so attackers cannot cheaply target only known reviewers.
